30A Escapes presents…” Summersalt”, a luxurious retreat in the heart of Seagrove Beach, just a 3-minute walk to Live Oak Beach Access and steps from Seaside. With 4 master suites, custom-built bunk rooms, a kids' playroom, and a stunning rooftop deck, this home is perfect for families and groups. Explore nearby shops and eateries at Seaside with ease on the 8 beach bikes. Your Seagrove Beach getaway starts here!

☆★ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ Steps to the Beach: Just a 3-minute walk to Live Oak Beach Access
✔ Sleeping Arrangements: 6 bedrooms for up to 18 guests: 4 master suites with king beds + 2 custom-built bunk rooms
✔ Rooftop Deck: Expansive rooftop space with sunset views
✔ Culinary Ready: Chef’s kitchen with oversized island and dining for 18
✔ Outdoor Fun: Private backyard with lush green space and covered patio seating
✔ Family Entertainment Ready: Kids’ playroom, high-speed Wi-Fi, and Smart TVs

✔ 8 Bikes Included: Adult beach bikes for guest use

Eager to Read More?
Here Are A Few Kind Words from Our Previous Guests:

“Home is well appointed and well cared for. Great location.” - Michael

☆★ SUMMERSALT RETREAT ☆★

Located in Seagrove Beach, just steps from the sand and a short bike ride to Seaside, Summersalt is a stunning vacation home designed for relaxation and connection. With four master suites, two custom bunk rooms, and a spectacular rooftop deck, this property is perfect for families and groups looking to make lasting memories. Whether you are lounging in the spacious living area, dining together in the chef’s kitchen, or unwinding on one of the private balconies, Summersalt offers comfort and luxury at every turn.

☆★ LIVING AREA ☆★

The first floor welcomes you with an open-concept design perfect for gathering. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the space with natural light, while stylish decor and cozy seating make it feel like home. Step outside to the private backyard for outdoor lounging or let the kids enjoy the dedicated playroom.

✔ Stylish Design: Bright, coastal-inspired interiors
✔ Spacious Comfort: Ample seating with plush sofas and armchairs
✔ Entertainment Ready: Smart TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, and kids' playroom
✔ Outdoor Access: Lush green space with a covered patio

☆★ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

The chef’s kitchen is a culinary haven, featuring modern stainless-steel appliances and an oversized island for meal prep and casual dining. Gather around the dining table for 10 or pull up a seat at the kitchen island with seating for 8.

✔ Chef’s Kitchen: Stainless steel appliances and ample counter space
✔ Fully Stocked: Cookware, utensils, glassware, and dishware
✔ Gather and Dine: Dining table for 10 + island seating for 8
✔ Coffee Lovers’ Delight: Keurig and standard coffee maker

☆★ OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ☆★

Step outside to your private backyard, perfect for relaxation and play. The covered patio offers cozy seating for lounging, while the lush green space invites outdoor fun. Upstairs, the rooftop deck provides a breathtaking setting to enjoy sunsets and make memories.

✔ Rooftop Deck: Expansive space with sunset views and Wet bar for entertaining
✔ Private Backyard: Lush lawn for kids’ play and relaxation
✔ Covered Patio: Comfortable seating for outdoor lounging

☆★ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

After a day of beach adventures, retreat to spacious bedrooms with luxurious touches and thoughtful amenities, adorned with hotel-grade linens.

1st Level:
✔ Primary King Suite: King bed, Smart TV, private En-suite with walk-in shower and dual sinks
✔ Powder room for guest convenience

☆★ SEAGROVE BEACH COMMUNITY ☆★

✔ Nature and Parks: Explore Point Washington and Deer Lake State Parks

✔ Dining Options: Dine at Surfing Deer, Café Thirty-A, and Old Florida Fish House
✔ Neighboring Communities: Just minutes from Seaside and Watersound
✔ Local Vibe: A mix of upscale boutiques and a casual beach vibe
✔ Relaxed Atmosphere: Diverse neighborhoods with charm and upbeat energy

☆★ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 8 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ There are active cameras located on the front porch, back patio, and the garage.
✔ To see a virtual tour of this home, please visit https://www.insidemaps.com/app/walkthrough-v2/?projectId=aDQuBp99l9&env=production
